target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.scope: global commercial-aviation accident census under IATA methodology
evidence.observation: The annual accident summary provides a year-wide reconciliation surface and includes Boeing occurrences used here, but BSFM has not yet completed a symmetric mapping of every fatal jet event against its frozen target.

evidence.publisher: National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), United States
evidence.observation: Boeing 737-7H4 N772SW, Southwest flight 1380, scheduled Part 121 passenger operation; one passenger fatality.

evidence.publisher: Instituto de Aeronáutica Civil de Cuba / accident investigation commission
evidence.scope: event-level; mirrored copy of identified authority report
evidence.observation: Boeing 737-201 XA-UHZ, commercial passenger flight DMJ 0972. Authority findings were publicly announced by IACC; 112 fatalities are reported in Cuban state reporting.
evidence.use: candidate authority evidence with provenance caveat

evidence.publisher: Papua New Guinea Accident Investigation Commission (AIC)
evidence.authority_role: investigation authority after FSM Annex 13 delegation
evidence.observation: Scheduled passenger flight PX073, Boeing 737-8BK P2-PXE; one passenger fatality. AIC records serial number 33024.

evidence.publisher: Komite Nasional Keselamatan Transportasi (KNKT), Republic of Indonesia
evidence.observation: Scheduled passenger flight LNI610, Boeing 737-8 MAX PK-LQP, 189 persons onboard; ATSB independently records all 189 fatally injured.

evidence.publisher: Guyana Aircraft Accident & Incident Investigation Unit (GAAIIU)
evidence.authority_role: state accident-investigation authority; report copy hosted by JCAA
evidence.observation: Boeing 757-200 N524AT; final report injuries table records one passenger fatality.

open_items: Map every 2018 fatal jet occurrence in the annual source universe and explicitly decide Boeing target membership.
Verify target-taxonomy treatment of delayed/post-accident fatalities consistently across the whole census, including FJA256.
Retain the P2-PXE serial-number discrepancy as an auditable source conflict; competent-authority value is 33024.
Do not treat five populated candidates as proof of annual completeness.

completeness_assessment.reason: Five Boeing fatal-commercial candidates now have event-level authority evidence and independent reconciliation, but the complete global fatal-jet universe has not yet been symmetrically mapped and target-taxonomy edge cases remain open.
